---
title: "About the EEID Workshop 2026"
---

The 2026 EEID associated workshop will be an **Introduction to Spatial Modeling**. 

The workshop will be taught by

- [Lauren Childs](https://math.vt.edu/people/faculty/childs-lauren.html)
- [Kate Langwig](https://www.langwiglab.org/)
- [Angela Peace](https://math.vt.edu/people/faculty/peace-angela.html)
- [Michael Robert](https://math.vt.edu/people/faculty/robert-michael.html)
- [Nick Ruktanonchai](https://vetmed.vt.edu/people/faculty/ruktanonchai-nick.html)
- [Omar Saucedo](https://math.vt.edu/people/faculty/saucedo-omar.html)

The EEID Workshop will involve collaborative sessions with the [Vectorbyte Training Workshop](https://vectorbyteorg.github.io/vectorbyte-training2026/).
